text.tspan: Share of global exports by income level of the trade partners
Share of global merchandise exports occurring between country pairs at different income levels.

tspan.tspan: "Rich" countries in this chart are Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Cyprus, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Iceland,

text.tspan: Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the United
States. "Non-rich" countries are all the other countries in the world for which data is available.
